concept: Review and integration: what it means to look for the truth so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of looking closely, testing ideas, and admitting when you're wrong — which feels most natural to you, and which feels hardest?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'seeking the truth' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
